authorized: User approved an additional calendar-day feature delay and separate retraining
origin: Row t predicts full UTC day D=t+1; all original features and vintage metadata come from t-2=D-3
market_proxy: Existing lag1 proxies therefore use an observed market return on D-4; never carry a market return across missing sessions
macro: Last two known observations within the requested ALFRED vintage at information day D-3, not a change between two capture dates
crypto: Same Coin Metrics date labeling as frozen baseline; own return and RMS at D-3 on a complete calendar grid
training_labels: Keep close+24h purging before first validation/test origin
samples: Identical dates for own vs macro without USD on long sample; identical dates for all three common variants with USD vintage>=2019-02-04
models: Same Elastic Net and histogram gradient boosting grids, training-only preprocessing, validation MSE/QLIKE selection, train+validation refit; no test tuning
variance: Same positive-variance transformations and smearing as completion; no prediction floor
inference: Paired eligible-origin loss differences, HAC5 finite correction; BH32 macro ablations, separately BH40 learned-versus-benchmark comparisons; approximate exploratory diagnostics
timing_comparison: Old and new timing evaluated on intersections of origin dates; descriptive, no new significance search

prospective.clock: Only log strictly before origin, with origin within next24h; actual receipt of every dependency<=origin-24h
prospective.information_day: D-3; capture after information day close and by cutoff; exact vintage requested for macro
prospective.models_frozen: No overwrite/refit once artifact inventory is frozen; use another version
prospective.capture: Immutable raw bytes, URL, UTC receipt, SHA256, requested-vintage metadata; local receipt is not independently provider-certified publication time
prospective.forecast_groups: Matched samples per asset; do not emit own-only forecasts on dates when declared matched macro prerequisites fail
prospective.labels: Capture outcomes after close+24h; retain their source hashes, never synthesize future labels
prospective.evaluation: No performance claim before fixed end; preserve missing forecasts and attempts; no interim tuning

limitations: Extra lag cannot remove historical revisions, establish causal identification or restore an already viewed test to untouched status
